positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Enabling Regulatory Readiness at scale through building infrastructure and AI-powered tooling

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Android
positions.description:
• Maintained an internationally available video streaming Android app which was written using Java, Kotlin, MVVM architecture, and RxJava. Led feature development of a promotional countdown banner, and debugged CI/CD issues causing UI test failures. Oversaw multiple app releases, performed security checks using Checkmarx, and investigated crashes using NewRelic. 

• Built a UI component system for a Casino application using Jetpack Compose and reactive programming with Kotlin Flows. Created and documented an extensible framework for integrating with different game providers using WebViews and JavaScript within the Android codebase. 

• Contributed to a nationally available banking app which was written using multi-module architecture and unidirectional data flow. Helped lead coordination across teams for the development of a new information 
hub within the app. Wrote integration tests for new features using Cucumber and Gherkin. 

• Administered interviews for candidates as a member of the Android interview team and onboarded new 
developers to client projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Android and Full Stack
positions.description:
• Built a Covid attestation Android app using MVVM architecture and Dagger for dependency injection. Used Retrofit for making network calls to a backend server, and used Wiremock to write end to end Espresso UI tests. Created a background service to launch on boot and notify users of their daily status using a DaggerBroadcastReceiver. 

• Worked as a full-stack engineer on a health care app which was built using test driven development and mob programming practices. Gained experience writing contract tests using Pact, and helped lead refactor efforts in the Android codebase's networking layer to simplify error handling. 

• Contributed a bugfix to the Jetpack Compose library in the Android Open Source Project and gave an internal presentation on the process. 

• Became a certified Google Android Developer.

positions.title: Software Developer - Azure Networking
positions.description:
Software Load Balancing Team 
• Designed and implemented a metric reporting pipeline which queried performance counters on Azure nodes, aggregated data, and reported metrics to MDM using C#.

• Wrote control plane code for the Software Load Balancing Team’s Managed Network Address Translation feature and configured runners to report the health of the service in different regions.

•Wrote bugfixes and added unit tests for Mux driver code written in C.

• Debugged live site issues through investigation and collaboration with other Azure teams during on-call rotation.

• Managed the roll-out of a software load balancing update across Azure nodes globally.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
International TV App
• Developed features and fixed bugs for an international TV provider's website.
• Utilized React and Redux to help create a JavaScript web app.
• Collaborated in an international team of developers, designers, and project managers.
• Worked with common web technologies like Webpack, TypeScript, Sass, Yarn, and Babel.

positions.title: Android Development Intern
positions.description:
Global News App
• Built features, fixed bugs, refactored code, and wrote tests for a global news Android app
• Aided in building an app using unidirectional data flow and MVVM architecture
• Collaborated in a team using the Scrum methodology
• Worked with popular Android libraries such as Dagger, Butterknife, RxJava, and Mockito

projects.title: NES Starship
projects.description:
• Programmed an NES game using Assembly 6502
• Studied the NES system architecture to define game ROM and write graphical data to the Picture Processing Unit
• Wrote a game loop including player input, enemy logic, entity allocation, and entity collision

projects.title: Voice Recognition for Spotify App
projects.description:
• Designed an Android app that allows users to play music from Spotify by issuing voice commands
• Programmed the app using Spotify's Java and Web APIs
• Implemented voice recognition features using Android's speech library and Carnegie Mellon University's Project Sphinx library
